responsibility: Implements -Wanalyzer-infinite-recursion detection on top of exploded-graph entry nodes and call strings. It identifies recursive re-entry to the same function, locates the previous recursive entry frame, compares region-model state across recursion levels to detect the absence of a changing variant, and emits a specialized pending_diagnostic with custom function-entry and final-path events that cross-reference the earlier entry and report mutual or direct recursion depth effects.
